integrity: Only ordinary four-denomination representations are counted. No independent audit or external certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The exact g1 and first generalized genus formulas are proved only in three congruence classes. The failure of a principal nonuniqueness ideal is proved in all complementary classes. Betti and classical Frobenius inputs originate in Robles-Perez and Rosales 2017; unindexed equivalent deductions remain possible.
title: A mod-six dichotomy for unique representations by consecutive tetrahedral numbers
